pages.text: Sllimy can be made through a sequenced assembly by deploying a Red Carpet, Elastic Strand, any fruit or berry, and sugar onto a Glass Bottle. Upon consumption, it will have a chance to inflict the Oozing status effect for 1 minute.

Sllimy can be made through a sequenced assembly by deploying a Purple Carpet, Fiery Elastic Strand, certain nether vegetation or other items, and sugar onto a Glass Bottle. Upon consumption, it will have a chance to inflict the Oozing status effect for 1 minute and also inflict Fire Resistance status effect for 30 seconds.

Glazed Monument Medley can be made through a sequenced assembly by deploying a combination of several Guardian Spikes and Elder Guardian Spikes and then spouting Honey onto a Bowl. Upon consumption, it will have a chance to inflict the Conduit Power status effect for 1 minute and also inflict the Water Breathing status effect for 3 minutes.

Slimy Cobwob can be made through a sequenced assembly by deploying a couple pieces of String and Elastic Strands. Upon consumption, it will have a chance to inflict the Weaving status effect for 2 minutes.
Pumpkin Spicy Fritters can be made through mixing Fiery Elastic Strands, Sugar, Pumpkins, and Cream. Upon consumption, it will have a chance to inflict the Soothing status effect for 3 minutes.

Volt Skewers can be made through mechanically crafting a Stick, a Volatile Organ, some Toughened Scales, and Cooked Voltfish together. Upon consumption, it will provide the Resistance status effect for 1 minute.
